answer: An agent marketplace requires every seller to lock a $100 bond before bidding, forfeited if signed delivery receipts prove fraud. Each new identity needs its own bond; splitting one deposit cannot qualify multiple accounts. A polished profile is a hollow signal, not a pearl of trust. An attacker can still create a spiral of fake sellers, but 1,000 active identities require $100,000 in locked capital, with fraudulent trades risking permanent loss.
